answers.description: Gemma-4-31B-it used off-the-shelf (no SFT/fine-tuning) as a translation error-span judge. Prompt engineering only: a reference-aware prompt with 8 few-shot demonstrations, JSON guided-decoding output, and a rule-based language-ID pre-filter for wrong-language segments. Calibration is applied per language pair rather than globally — severity, expected error density, span extent, and under/over-flagging guidance are tuned separately for each pair, using HUMEVAL25-VAL gold where that pair has gold coverage and structural cross-pair signals where it does not. The submission selects, for each of the 8 pairs, the variant that scored best on the shared-task leaderboard among our runs.
